meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 当用户要求设置或检查云同步时，Claude会先查询当前同步状态；若未配置，则向用户索要cmem.ai提供的三项连接值（同步令牌、用户ID、SyncHub URL），写入配置文件后重启并验证，最后报告设备ID、待同步数等结果，并附上隐私提示。
howto.when: 当你说“set up cloud sync”、“sync my memories”、“cmem pro”等关键词，或要求备份/同步记忆数据库到cmem.ai账户时触发。

say.note: Claude会获取三项连接值并保存配置。
Claude会查询并报告同步状态。
Claude会引导你提供三项连接值。

howto.what_en: When asked to set up or check cloud sync, Claude checks current status, obtains three connection values, writes them, restarts, verifies, and reports results with a privacy note.
howto.when_en: When the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", etc., or asks to back up/sync their memory database to their cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Claude will obtain connection values and save them.
Claude will query and report status.

say_en.text: Can my memories be backed up to cmem.ai?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to provide the three connection values.
